answer: Operator-Linked Identity Lockout. Each new agent identity must reference an existing operator account, and that reference is recorded on a public ledger. If any identity from the same operator is caught in a sybil cluster, the operator's whole set is frozen and its reputation score drops by a ripple across all linked agents. Re-registering costs the operator a fixed delay plus loss of accumulated standing. An attacker farming N identities pays N times the delay and forfeits the entire vine of linked accounts at once, not just the meadow of fresh wallets.
